notes: Candidate Pb-Bi system built from the Yoon & Lee (1998) assessment as represented in the open NIST solder database. The database explicitly tags the Bi-Pb liquid, FCC_A1, and HCP_A3 interaction parameters as 98Yoo. Pure-element and lattice-stability functions are taken from the NIST/SGTE compilation. This candidate is intentionally marked unverified pending comparison with the original Yoon & Lee equations and independent numerical reproduction of the NIST invariant equilibria.
